title: Precision Lanes PRD: scope matrix and launch checklist for hosted endpoints (chat / completions / embeddings / rerank)
creator: Maya Kapoor
description: Purpose: define a minimal-but-safe PRD and launch checklist to deliver a set of 'Precision Lanes' for the hosted inference surface: carefully scoped chat, completions, embeddings, and rerank endpoints with explicit behavioral contracts, telemetry, and staged rollout gates. The goal is to ship a predictable developer experience for common production workloads while limiting the initial surface and acceptance risk. This ticket captures scope boundaries, specific acceptance criteria (functional, performance, op readiness), unresolved questions, rollout plan, and a concrete launch checklist with owners.
scope_inclusions: Chat endpoint: single-turn and multi-turn session token handling, streaming responses, stop-token semantics, and function/tool calling pass-through for first-party tool integrations.
Completions endpoint: support for prompt templates, temperature/top-p controls, max tokens, and deterministic sampling options (seeded/temperature=0).
Embeddings endpoint: batched request support, 3 model tiers (fast / balanced / high-accuracy), cosine-normalized vector output, per-request metadata passthrough.
Rerank endpoint: candidate scoring contract, stable ordering, optional explanation field (top-k contribution scores), and batching for up to 50 candidates per request.
Behavioral contracts document describing canonical examples and edge cases for each endpoint (stored in Confluence link).
Telemetry: token-level cost breakdown, latency p95/p99, model variant used, and quality signals (per-PR evals).
Rollout gating: eval-driven quality gate, SLO thresholds, and canary slice with traffic ramping rules.
scope_exclusions: Multi-modal inputs (images/audio) — out of initial launch scope.
Enterprise-only private VPC packaging — this is a hosted-first launch.
Automatic quantization flows for customer-provided models.
Custom tool integrations for third-party connectors beyond first-party tool shim.
acceptance_criteria: Functional: Each endpoint responds to canonical request templates and returns valid, schema-conformant output for at least 95% of synthetic test cases created by DX team.

Behavioral: For 10 curated prompt families per endpoint, absolute behavioral delta vs baseline model must be <= 3% on key eval metrics (relevance/accuracy/consistency) measured by the evaluation harness.

Performance: p95 latency under target per-lane (chat: 180ms for small prompts; completions: 150ms; embeddings: 120ms; rerank: 250ms) on standard test harness at 50 rps sustained with configured dedicated lane capacity.
Reliability: Error rate <= 0.5% (5xx/4xx combined) in full test run for 48-hour soak on staging with simulated tenant mix.
Observability: Traces, logs, and token-level cost telemetry emitted and visible in Console for all test calls; sampling and retention configured per observability runbook.

Rollout/Gating: Canary slice evaluation shows no quality regression and meets SLOs for 48h before 25% ramp; auto-rollback rule defined if p95 latency or error rate breaches by +30% or quality delta > 5%.
Security/Compliance: KMS encryption in transit and at rest enabled for tenant artifacts; SSO access control to the admin rollout controls verified by Security.
Docs & DX: Quickstart examples for each endpoint, SDK snippets, and an 'upgrade notes' doc created and reviewed by DevRel.
open_questions: What is the final membership of the 10 prompt families used for behavioral gating? (input from Solutions and Customer Success required).
Should rerank explanation scores be considered PII if they contain token-level attributions? Need Security sign-off.
Do we enable deterministic sampling (seeded) by default for completions lane or surface behind a flag? Impacts caching and determinism tests.
What tenant isolation level will the initial hosted lanes guarantee for high-volume customers? (affects Dedicated handoff plan).
rollout_plan: Stage 0: Internal alpha — runtime team deploys to internal staging cluster; eng + pm + design run through canonical scenarios (2 weeks).
Stage 1: Partner canary — 2 trusted customers (opt-in) on 5% traffic slice; run behavior eval suite and performance soak (48h).
Stage 2: Gradual ramp — 5% -> 25% -> 50% over 72h windows conditioned on quality and SLO checks.
Stage 3: GA — open to all tenants with communication plan and migration notes.
Rollback policy: automated rollback if error rate > 0.5% absolute or if eval quality delta exceeds 5 percentage points on critical prompts.
Post-launch: 30-day observation window with weekly quality regressions review and automated alerts to core squad.
